items.title: AT&T and Verizon tumble as Musk’s SpaceX plots direct mobile threat
items.summary: AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile took a beating on Wednesday as investors braced for an orbital clash with Elon Musk. Shares of AT&T (NYSE: T) and Verizon (NYSE: VZ) both fell 4%, while T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS) slid 2%, following a Semafor report that SpaceX is plotting a direct assault on the U.S. wireless oligopoly. items.title: T Mobile (TMUS) Faces Nationwide Outage That Hit Customers And Network Partners
items.summary: Major outage disrupted T-Mobile US mobile service for thousands of customers across the US. The issue affected both T-Mobile and providers that rely on its network. Service reliability and customer experience were impacted while the outage was being addressed. T-Mobile US, listed as NasdaqGS:TMUS, is a nationwide wireless operator that relies on consistent network uptime to support its core business.
